# Project Completion Form (digital version of the owner's current form)

Header: MD Golden Builders logo · CSLB Lic. #1128874
Auto-filled: Client name · Project address · Phone number · Date

Customer answers Yes / No to each (any "No" requires a comment and creates a punch-list task):

1. Was the construction work completed at your residence?
2. Is everything in working condition?
3. Were the materials (rough and/or finished) provided by the company in good condition?
4. Were the materials (rough or finished) installed and/or applied properly?
5. Were the installed components aligned and positioned correctly?
6. Were all finishes and touch-ups done and completed?

Statement: "I, {{customer_full_name}}, agree that the construction / remodeling work done at
my property {{property_address}} is fully completed."
Signature (e-sign) · Date (auto)

**Added in the app (new):**
- Warranty block: "MD Golden Builders warrants its workmanship for **{{warranty_years}} year(s)**
  from {{completion_date}} for: {{warranty_scope}}." (1 or 5 years, chosen per project)
- After signing → customer receives signed PDF + thank-you email with review links
  (Google / Yelp / Thumbtack); project moves to `Completed`; final payment invoice sent.
